scripts.setup: pnpm --dir frontend install --frozen-lockfile && go -C gateway mod download && cargo fetch --manifest-path engine/Cargo.toml
scripts.dev:engine: cargo build --manifest-path engine/Cargo.toml -p encorehub-rust-scrapling && node scripts/run-with-protoc.mjs cargo run --manifest-path engine/Cargo.toml --features standalone --bin encorehub-engine
scripts.check: pnpm run test:contracts && pnpm run check:engine && pnpm run check:gateway && pnpm run check:frontend
scripts.build:engine: node scripts/run-with-protoc.mjs cargo build --manifest-path engine/Cargo.toml --release --features standalone --bin encorehub-engine && cargo build --manifest-path engine/Cargo.toml --release -p encorehub-rust-scrapling
scripts.test: pnpm run test:contracts && pnpm run test:engine && pnpm run test:gateway && pnpm run test:frontend
scripts.test:contracts: node --test scripts/workspace-contract.test.mjs scripts/docs-contract.test.mjs scripts/generate-oss-compliance.test.mjs scripts/build-components.test.mjs scripts/ci-jobs.test.mjs scripts/release-metadata.test.mjs scripts/versioning.test.mjs
scripts.test:engine: node scripts/run-with-protoc.mjs cargo test --manifest-path engine/Cargo.toml --workspace && node scripts/run-with-protoc.mjs cargo test --manifest-path engine/Cargo.toml -p encorehub-engine --all-targets --features standalone
scripts.test:frontend: pnpm --dir frontend test --run && pnpm --dir frontend test:bundle
scripts.lint: pnpm run test:contracts && pnpm run lint:engine && pnpm run lint:gateway && pnpm run lint:frontend
scripts.lint:engine: cargo fmt --manifest-path engine/Cargo.toml --all -- --check && node scripts/run-with-protoc.mjs cargo clippy --manifest-path engine/Cargo.toml --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings && node scripts/run-with-protoc.mjs cargo clippy --manifest-path engine/Cargo.toml -p encorehub-engine --all-targets --features standalone -- -D warnings
scripts.format: pnpm run format:engine && pnpm run format:gateway && pnpm run format:frontend
